english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese way to express a large amount of something.
This is the all-purpose choice for a large number, including emphatic “so many.”
Use this when English some means a considerable or fairly large quantity or number.

examples.english: I bought much more fruit than usual.
examples.traditional: 我買咗比平時多好多水果。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bei2 ping4 si4 do1 hou2 do1 seoi2 gwo2
